in_marathi.name: Akhilbhav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhilbhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akhilbhav is a Sanskrit name that means 'supreme wisdom' or 'all-knowing'. In Hindu mythology, Akhilbhav is the name of Lord Vishnu's divine discus or Sudarshana Chakra, which is known to destroy evil and maintain balance in the universe.

vedic_reference.note: The name Akhilbhav is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘अखिल’ (akhil) and ‘भव’ (bhav), meaning ‘All-Pervading’ or ‘Universal Existence’. It is a name that symbolizes the concept of the universe being pervaded by existence and consciousness.
